description.narrative: The Punjab State Road Sector Project for India aims at increasing the service levels of the state roads through: (a) eliminating the growing bottlenecks in the network; (b) increasing vehicle speeds by providing additional geometric capacity; (c) reducing transport costs by reducing road roughness; (d) reducing accidents; (e) strengthening Government of Punjab capacity to plan and manage the network; and (f) providing adequate road maintenance for network sustainability. The project consists of the following components: 1: The project will fund: (a) civil works along plan roads comprising upgrading, rehabilitation and periodic maintenance of about 1,000 km; (b) technical assistance for the selection, and the design and construction supervision of these works; and (c) land acquisition, the required pre-construction activities, and the implementation of social and environmental safeguards. 2: The Government of Punjab has identified major short comings with respect to organizational aspects, core processes, financial systems and the status of use of Information Technology (IT) systems in the road sector agencies.

The project objective is to improve operating conditions of State roads for road users, in a sustainable way, thus helping toprovide the business enabling environment necessary to support Punjab's economic development strategy.

Finance Agreement :Flow of Funds | Description :GOP shall transfer funds to PRBDB within fourteen (14) calendar days of its receiptfrom GOI. | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :Institutional Strengthening | Description :GOP shall take all necessary measures to ensure that the Frameworkwhich includes Action Plan for Enhancing Transparency and Accountability, is revised and amended without Bank's prior approval. |Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :Management Information Systems | Description :PRBDB shall design and operationalize by January 31, 2008, aManagement Information System acceptable to the Bank for the monitoring of project implementation | Due Date :31-Jan-2008
